description: This file is a test program for the AlServiceAccessPoint class, demonstrating registration, reception of data units, and printing payloads, primarily used for testing or debugging in the al-sap component.

classes.name: AlServiceAccessPoint
classes.description: Class providing access point functionalities, such as registration and data indication.

classes.name: AlServiceRegistrationRequest
classes.description: Represents a registration request with specific activation and service type parameters.

classes.name: AlServiceRegistrationResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a registration request, including MAC address data.

classes.name: AlServiceDataUnit
classes.description: Represents a data unit transmitted over the service, including payload content.

classes.name: AlServiceException
classes.description: Exception class used for handling errors from the AlService framework.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Entry point of the program, performs registration with the service and enters a loop to receive and display data units.
